title: MZ RPG Maker MZ Battle Grid Support

posts.author: Arrow8
posts.body:
Hi everyone! I am brand brand brand new to RPG Maker and I am struggling with several issues, but I will only ask about one at the moment.  I am using the Battle Grid System Plug-In In, and I am having trouble bringing both the enemies and the actor's grids toward each other. I can either have all the actors on the screen or all the enemies on the screen, but not both. I played around a lot with Grid Node Offsets and Actor & Enemy Sprite Offsets, but I could never find the happy medium.   I am sure I am missing something simple, if anyone knows of the issue please let me know.
PS The grid wasn't exactly what I wanted; I wanted something where I could have different formations for the actors. For example, if they are in an "ABC" formation, they have bonuses for these stats. If they are in the "XYZ" formation, they get bonuses for other stats.  Plus I wanted something where I can make some rules that actor's in the back are harder to hit than actors in the front. So, if you know something similar to what I originally wanted, please let me know. Thanks!
PPS I know I got plenty of other issues that I need address from my screen shot below, I am just tackling one issue at a time. Thanks!
Here is the link for the plugin:
http://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/Battle_Grid_System_VisuStella_MZ
-Arrow

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body: Hello! I think for starters it would help if you provided a link to the plugin.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome! Just a few suggestions for you:
- Definitely provide a link to the plugin and also provide screenshots of whatever you've tried in whatever plugin parameter controls this.
- If you're brand brand new to RPG Maker, I'd personally strongly advise you not be messing with plugins at all yet, never mind complicated ones.
It's much more valuable to learn how RPG Maker's default systems work, and to get comfortable with eventing - you should make a few very short test games to practice creating different bits of gameplay before modding anything so drastically with plugins.

If they are in "XYZ" formation they bonuses to other stats.  Plus I wanted something where I can make some rules that actor's in the back are harder to hit than actors in the front. So if you know something similar to what I was originally wanting please let me know. Thanks!

There was a Row Formation plugin for RPG Maker MV that did exactly what you're looking for - unfortunately, no one has made a version of it for MZ as far as I know.
It might work with MZ via Project FOSSIL, but then you're spending money on an MV plugin and hoping it will work correctly in your project - not something I'd personally advise.
You could try Googling things like "formation" plugins, but I haven't seen anyone reference one.
